title: Layer-wise Alignment: Examining Safety Alignment Across Image Encoder Layers in Vision Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates safety alignment in Vision-Language Models, specifically focusing on a vulnerability where early layer exits can bypass safety filters to produce harmful content (like bomb-making instructions). While safety alignment is a subset of AI ethics, the paper focuses on technical vulnerabilities and training methods (RLHF) to mitigate harmful outputs rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, or specific philosophical ethics.
